name: Orveil Self-Hosted Monitoring
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted monitoring software; 43 monitor types, incidents, SLA reports, alerts and status pages; no published software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker host, MongoDB, storage and operations. Configure JWT secret, admin credentials, TLS and network access before public deployment; optional notification, AI and S3 services may incur external costs. Free software does not include free VPS resources.
